script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Psychological
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. CONTEMPORARY APARTMENT - NIGHT

A dimly lit room, filled with the soft sound of rain. A WOMAN IN HER 30s, JANE, sits at a small desk, staring at a laptop screen. She wears glasses, a sweater, and her hair is pulled back into a messy bun.

JANE
(whispering to herself)
One more round of edits. One more.

Suddenly, a power outage plunges the room into darkness. Jane groans and reaches for her phone to check the time.

JANE
(into phone)
Another power outage? Seriously?

INT. JANE'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jane enters the living room, candle in hand, and lights it. She sits on the couch, staring at the blank TV screen. The sound of rain continues to fill the room.

Suddenly, there's a knock on the door. Jane hesitates, then goes to answer it.

INT. HALLWAY - NIGHT

Jane opens the door to reveal a MAN IN HIS 40S, MIKE, standing in the rain. He's disheveled, wearing a wet t-shirt and jeans.

MIKE
(panting)
Jane, I need your help.

Jane looks at him, unsure.

JANE
What do you want, Mike? It's late, and I have work to do.

MIKE
(pleading)
It's important, Jane. I lost my job today, and I have nowhere to go. Can I stay here for a night?

Jane hesitates, then nods.

JANE
Fine, but you have to keep it down. I have work to do.

INT. JANE'S BEDROOM - MORNING

Jane wakes up to the sound of Mike's snoring. She groans and gets out of bed, putting on her glasses and robe.

JANE
(whispering)
Mike, you said you'd keep it down.

INT. JANE'S KITCHEN - MORNING

Jane makes coffee and sits at the kitchen table, staring at her laptop. Mike enters, wearing a towel around his waist.

MIKE
(awkwardly)
Good morning, Jane. I'll make myself some coffee.

JANE
(sternly)
No, you won't. I'll make it for you.

INT. JANE'S LIVING ROOM - AFTERNOON

Jane and Mike sit on the couch, watching the rain outside. Jane types on her laptop, while Mike looks over her shoulder.

MIKE
(curious)
What are you working on?

JANE
(hesitant)
A screenplay. I've been trying to get it right for months.

MIKE
(supportively)
You can do it, Jane. I believe in you.

INT. CONTEMPORARY APARTMENT BUILDING - EVENING

Jane and Mike walk through the dark, empty hallways of Jane's apartment building. They stop at a door, and Mike looks at Jane nervously.

MIKE
(anxiously)
Jane, I don't want to impose, but I really have nowhere to go. Can I stay here for a while longer?

JANE
(thoughtfully)
I'll think about it. But in the meantime, you need to start looking for a job.

INT. JANE'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jane and Mike sit on the couch, staring at job listings on Jane's laptop. Mike types out his resume, while Jane gives him suggestions.

MIKE
(excitedly)
I think I found something! It's not my dream job, but it's a start.

JANE
(proudly)
That's great, Mike. Keep going.

INT. JANE'S APARTMENT - MORNING

Jane wakes up early, before Mike, and goes to the kitchen to make coffee. She sits at the table, staring at her laptop screen.

Suddenly, she gets an email. She reads it, then jumps up and runs to the living room.

JANE
(excitedly)
Mike! You won't believe this!

MIKE
( groggily)
What is it?

JANE
(grinning)
My screenplay won first place in a competition! I've gotten an offer from a production company!

MIKE
(ecstatically)
That's amazing, Jane! Congratulations!

JANE
(hugging him)
Thank you, Mike. I couldn't have done it without you.

INT. CONTEMPORARY APARTMENT - DAY

Jane and Mike sit on the couch, watching the rain outside. They talk about their future plans, their careers, and their dreams.

MIKE
(smiling)
I'm glad I met you, Jane. You've been a real inspiration.

JANE
(smiling back)
And you've been a great help, Mike. I couldn't have done it without you.

INT. JANE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jane sits at her desk, staring at her laptop screen. She smiles as she reads the email again, then starts typing.

JANE
(whispering to herself)
I've got this.

FADE OUT.
